import base64,hashlib,json,math,time,zlib
from fractions import Fraction as F
from pathlib import Path
t=time.monotonic()
new=json.loads(Path('coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-SOURCE-PRODUCT-RN64-001-CODEX.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
oldpath=Path('coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-UNIT-RN64-001-CODEX.json')
assert hashlib.sha256(oldpath.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='e920ad271b1d00ada8c9d85a496556d5ac78644bc146a885a0ee4962a75e4609'
old=json.loads(oldpath.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
for n,h in old['code_doc_sha256'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,n
def payload(r):
    run=r['run'];raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(run['stdout_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
    assert len(raw)==run['stdout_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==run['stdout_sha256']
    return json.loads(raw)
a=payload(new);units=payload(old)['audit']['cases']
srcpath=Path('coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-QUARTER-SOURCE-OPS-001-CODEX.json')
assert hashlib.sha256(srcpath.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='c3a54d51c47f901d4c0520216499c027a24c9579742e9b28a57073c72053d2a0'
sources=payload(json.loads(srcpath.read_text(encoding='utf-8')))['cases']
phase=payload(json.loads(Path('coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-PHASE-QUOTIENT-001-CODEX.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')))['audit']['cases']
def pow2(e):return F(2**e) if e>=0 else F(1,2**(-e))
def dec(w,bits):
    mant,exponent,bias=(52,11,1023) if bits==64 else (23,8,127)
    assert type(w) is int and 0<=w<2**bits
    e=(w>>mant)&((1<<exponent)-1);m=w&((1<<mant)-1)
    assert e!=(1<<exponent)-1
    return (-1 if w>>(bits-1) else 1)*F(((1<<mant)+m) if e else m)*pow2(e-bias-mant if e else 1-bias-mant)
def nearest(q,w):
    e=(w>>52)&2047;m=w&((1<<52)-1)
    assert e!=2047 and (e or m==0)
    candidates=[]
    for v in {w,w-1,w+1,0,1,1<<63,(1<<63)+1}:
        if 0<=v<2**64 and ((v>>52)&2047)!=2047:
            candidates.append((abs(q-dec(v,64)),v&1))
    assert (abs(q-dec(w,64)),w&1)==min(candidates)
    return dec(w,64)
node_count=0
def measure(m):
    global node_count
    sh=[dec(w,32) for w in m['source_limb_uint32']];u,v=[dec(w,64) for w in m['unit_uint64']]
    assert len(sh)==4
    assert all((w>>23)&255 or w&((1<<23)-1)==0 for w in m['source_limb_uint32'])
    ops=m['operations'];assert len(ops)==m['RN64_operations']==8;i=0
    def consume(a,b,op,label):
        nonlocal i
        node=ops[i];i+=1
        assert node['op']==op and node['label']==label
        assert [F(*v) for v in node['inputs_rational']]==[a,b]
        exact=a+b if op=='add' else (a-b if op=='sub' else a*b)
        out=nearest(exact,node['output_uint64']);delta=out-exact
        assert F(*node['rounding_delta_rational'])==delta
        return out,delta,node['output_uint64']
    ar,dr,_=consume(sh[0],sh[1],'add','decode.real')
    ai,di,_=consume(sh[2],sh[3],'add','decode.imag')
    ac,dac,_=consume(ar,u,'mul','mul.ac');bd,dbd,_=consume(ai,v,'mul','mul.bd')
    ad,dad,_=consume(ar,v,'mul','mul.ad');bc,dbc,_=consume(ai,u,'mul','mul.bc')
    re,dre,wr=consume(ac,bd,'sub','combine.real');im,dim,wi=consume(ad,bc,'add','combine.imag')
    assert m['output_uint64']==[wr,wi]
    assert [F(*v) for v in m['decoded_source_rational']]==[ar,ai]
    assert [F(*v) for v in m['source_exact_limb_sum_rational']]==[sh[0]+sh[1],sh[2]+sh[3]]
    assert [F(*v) for v in m['observed_path_field_rational']]==[re,im]
    actual=[re-(ar*u-ai*v),im-(ar*v+ai*u)]
    assert actual==[dac-dbd+dre,dad+dbc+dim]
    ep=sum(map(abs,(dac,dbd,dad,dbc,dre,dim)),F(0));ed=abs(dr)+abs(di)
    assert F(*m['source_decode_error_L1_upper_rational'])==ed
    assert F(*m['product_error_L1_upper_rational'])==ep
    assert F(*m['actual_product_error_L1_rational'])==sum(map(abs,actual),F(0))<=ep
    node_count+=8
    return sh,ed,ep,[re,im]
piL=F('3.14159265358979323846264338327950288419716939937510')
piH=F('3.14159265358979323846264338327950288419716939937511')
def perm(v,k):
    c,s=v;k%=4
    return [c,s] if k==0 else ([-s,c] if k==1 else ([-c,-s] if k==2 else [s,-c]))
def mul(z,u):return [z[0]*u[0]-z[1]*u[1],z[0]*u[1]+z[1]*u[0]]
case_nodes=0;oracles=0;errors={}
cases=a['audit']['cases'];assert set(cases)==set(units)==set(sources)
for name,c in cases.items():
    unit=units[name];source=sources[name];tr=source['transport']
    for key in ['original_scene_binding_sha256','decoded_scene_binding_sha256']:assert c[key]==unit[key]==tr[key]
    assert c['previous_full_case_accepted']==unit['previous_full_case_accepted']
    for flag in ['accepted_full_field_pipeline','scene_field_reduced','detector_evaluated','coherent_group_budget_certified','GPU_executed','ALU_executed','native_promotion_allowed','execution_authenticated','old_scene_unit_quotient_or_producer_rerun']:assert c[flag] is False
    zero=source['field_values_computed'] or source.get('reason')=='decoded phase is not an exact quarter cycle; no approximation/fallback'
    admitted=zero and tr['accepted_CPU_transport_budget_only'] and unit['accepted_propagation_unit_CPU_only']
    assert c['path_field_values_computed']==admitted
    if not admitted:
        assert c['RN64_operations']==0 and not c['paths'] and not c['accepted_source_product_absolute_CPU_only']
        continue
    srcs=tr['source_transport']['sources'];assert [p['source_id'] for p in c['paths']]==[s['source_id'] for s in srcs]
    assert c['field_absolute_L1_budget_rational']==tr['field_absolute_L1_budget']
    count=0
    for p,s,up,con,ph in zip(c['paths'],srcs,unit['paths'],tr['contributions'],phase[name]['paths']):
        assert p['source_id']==s['source_id']==up['source_id']==con['source_id']==ph['source_id']
        assert p['port']==con['port'] and p['coherence_group']==s['coherence_group']==con['coherence_group']
        assert p['phase_reference_id']=='ideal-scene-source-gauge:'+c['original_scene_binding_sha256']
        assert p['path_phase_reference_id']==up['phase_reference_id']==ph['phase_reference_id']
        m=p['measurement'];count+=8
        assert m['source_limb_uint32']==[w for comp in s['components'] for w in comp['limb_uint32']]
        assert m['unit_uint64']==[w^(1<<63) for w in up['propagation_unit_uint64']]
        sh,ed,ep,observed=measure(m)
        original=[F(*v['input_binary64_rational']) for v in s['components']]
        assert [F(*v) for v in p['source_original_rational']]==original
        sums=[sh[0]+sh[1],sh[2]+sh[3]];es=sum((abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(original,sums)),F(0))
        un=sum((abs(dec(w,64)) for w in m['unit_uint64']),F(0));an=sum(map(abs,original),F(0))
        eu=F(*up['composed_unit_error_L1_upper_rational'])
        assert F(*p['source_encoding_error_L1_rational'])==es
        assert F(*p['original_amplitude_L1_rational'])==an==F(*con['original_amplitude_L1_upper_rational'])
        assert F(*p['observed_unit_L1_rational'])==un and F(*p['retained_unit_error_L1_upper_rational'])==eu
        charges={'source_encoding':es*un,'source_decode':ed*un,'unit_phase_numeric':an*eu,'product_RN':ep}
        b=sum(charges.values(),F(0));budget=F(*tr['field_absolute_L1_budget'])
        assert {k:F(*v) for k,v in p['error_charges_L1_rational'].items()}==charges
        assert F(*p['composed_path_field_error_L1_upper_rational'])==b
        assert F(*p['field_absolute_L1_budget_rational'])==budget
        assert p['accepted_source_product_absolute_CPU_only']==(b<=budget)
        # Original source AND original geometry, with mirror -1 only at proved zero.
        cycles=F(*ph['original_length_BU'])/F(*ph['wavelength_BU_rational'])
        orig_u=cycles-ph['selector']['CPU_integer_turn']-F(up['quarter_CPU_index'],4)
        x=(piL+piH)*orig_u;assert abs(x)<=1
        cc=sum((F((-1)**j)*x**(2*j)/math.factorial(2*j) for j in range(21)),F(0))
        ss=sum((F((-1)**j)*x**(2*j+1)/math.factorial(2*j+1) for j in range(20)),F(0))
        uu=[-v for v in perm([cc,ss],up['quarter_CPU_index'])]
        oracle=mul(original,uu)
        actual=sum((abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(observed,oracle)),F(0))
        remainder=an*(abs(x)**41/math.factorial(41)+abs(x)**42/math.factorial(42)+2*abs(orig_u)*(piH-piL))
        assert actual+remainder<=b,(name,actual,b)
        errors[name]=max(errors.get(name,F(0)),actual+remainder);oracles+=1
    assert c['RN64_operations']==count;case_nodes+=count
    assert c['accepted_source_product_absolute_CPU_only']==all(p['accepted_source_product_absolute_CPU_only'] for p in c['paths'])
for m in a['primitives'].values():measure(m)
assert case_nodes==a['audit']['RN64_operations']==128 and node_count==136 and oracles==16
print(json.dumps({'validated':True,'elapsed_s':time.monotonic()-t,'pins':len(old['code_doc_sha256']),
    'RN64_nodes':node_count,'original_source_length_field_oracles':oracles,'source_product_partial_pass':sum(c['accepted_source_product_absolute_CPU_only'] for c in cases.values()),
    'previous_fullcase_accepted':sum(c['previous_full_case_accepted'] for c in cases.values()),'previous_FAIL':sum(not c['previous_full_case_accepted'] for c in cases.values()),'full_field_promotions':0,
    'nonquarter_oracle_error_plus_remainder_approx':float(errors['nonquarter_FAIL']),
    'nonquarter_bound_L1_approx':float(F(*cases['nonquarter_FAIL']['paths'][0]['composed_path_field_error_L1_upper_rational'])),
    'raw_sha256':new['run']['stdout_sha256']},sort_keys=True))
